factsheet.heading: Forgotten stories at Ally Pally
paragraphs:
Join Linda Gyamfi, a Heritage Champion for Bruce Castle Museum & Archive and a member of the Golden Key Academy, for a journey into the forgotten stories at Alexandra Palace. Driven by a curiosity about people, places and histories that often go untold, Linda invites guests to discover Ally Pally through a different lens — exploring the site's overlooked connections to empire, Commonwealth histories and public memory through stories, discussion and historical sources.
Alexandra Palace is one of London's most recognisable landmarks, but beneath its familiar skyline lie remarkable stories that often go unnoticed. Together, we will uncover the story of the Commonwealth troops who gathered here for King Edward VII's Coronation in 1902, using historic photographs and an early map of the area to bring these hidden histories to life. The tour also touches on some difficult histories connected to how people were displayed and represented during this period, which some guests may find sensitive. Along the way, we'll explore how familiar places can hold complex stories, inviting us to look again at the landscapes around us and the histories they continue to shape.

factsheet.heading: What to expect and access needs
paragraphs: This tour will take place predominantly outdoors across Alexandra Palace and Alexandra Park.
Please be aware that the route includes hills, sloping and uneven paths, some narrow pavements, and both stepped and step-free sections.
Please wear comfortable footwear and clothing suitable for the weather. There may also be an opportunity to view a small display of historic photographs, subject to availability.
If you have specific access requirements, please contact Alexandra Palace Visitor Services at access@alexandrapalace.com before attending.
Further accessibility information is available at: https://www.alexandrapalace.com/visitor-information/accessibility/

factsheet.heading: Golden Key Academy
paragraphs: The Golden Key Academy is a course training up insightful and engaging guides dedicated to explaining London and bringing its many stories to life. This tour is part of a wider collection of tours created by Golden Key Academy guides for the Open House Festival celebrating their conclusion of the eight month course.
Further information on the Golden Key Academy can be found here https://open-city.org.uk/golden-key-academy
If you would like to attend this tour, please ensure you have booked a ticket before turning up.
